title: Chapter 275 Actively Attacking Jiujiuliu City
content:
Chapter 275 Actively Attacking Jiujiuliu City

In the defense of the Naga desert main city, without the threat of the poisonous ray scorpion, it is difficult for the desert races gathered around to break through the firepower network of the Zerg destroyers, let alone capture the heavily defended main city of the Naga tribe.

If there is a strong army to attack, the poisonous ray scorpion controlled by the Zerg can counterattack at a critical moment.

Under such defense, the recent defense of the Naga desert main city is no problem.

In the next defensive operations, the Zerg destroyers will continue to serve as the firepower output tool of the Naga army.

With the perfect command and control of the Queen, Wu Qing does not need to worry about the defense of the Naga desert main city.

…

A new day begins.

Public battlefield in the southern theater.

The strongest main combat force of the Zerg, which has rested for a while, can no longer continue to be idle in the first Zerg sub-base under the 66th city.

For the Zerg, this is a huge waste of combat power, which seriously hinders the rapid development of the Zerg.

Through the analysis of intelligence collected by a large number of Zerg hosts in the past two days, Wu Qing chose a frontline city within the sphere of influence of the alien race as the target of attack.

The geographical location and urban functions of this target city of the alien race are similar to the 66th city previously occupied by the cattle race.

The target city is not far from the 66th city. It is an important rest and supply city for the armies of the alien race, a major transportation route to other cities, and a frontline base for attacking the local camp.

The diverse urban functions make the target city very prosperous, with a large number of troops and various logistics service personnel stationed there.

According to the intelligence obtained from the reconnaissance of the Zerg host, the permanent garrison of the target city is about five million, and there are nearly ten million people of various kinds living there.

What's more troublesome is that there are a large number of troops from other places who often rest in this city.

Because not long ago, the army of the alien race had already attacked the main city of the local camp, and the army of the alien race was heavily invested in the sphere of influence of the local camp to fight. At this time, many of the armies of the alien race after the war were resting and replenishing in the city.

The news that the Zerg defeated the alien army and recovered the 66th city must have spread. The alien army that was originally going to enter the local camp's sphere of influence to fight after resting and replenishing supplies stayed in the target city, waiting for subsequent combat orders.

Therefore, the total number of alien troops in the target city must exceed 10 million, and the other population also exceeds 10 million. It is a large city with a population of more than 20 million.

In the 66th city, the huge city-building team of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce has arrived. Under the coordination and command of Gong Yi, the reconstruction of the city has begun.

With the assistance of a large number of engineering machinery and creations of the Goblin tribe, the reconstruction of the city is very fast.

Wu Qing also sent a large number of Zerg worker bees to follow the command of the Goblin city construction experts to do some excavation, cleaning and transportation work. With the Zerg worker bees taking on various heavy tasks, the reconstruction of the 66th city is much faster than the plan of the Goblin city construction experts.

For the reconstruction of the 66th city, the Queen of the Zerg and the Goblin city construction experts have communicated. The reconstruction plan was jointly formulated by both parties, and the Goblin city construction experts were responsible for supervision.

After this cooperation, the Queen of Zerg has a more detailed understanding of the city construction in this world, and the experts of the Goblin tribe have also learned a lot of novel and unique city construction knowledge from the Queen of Zerg.

Both sides have gained something and are very happy.

Wu Qing's Zerg clone found Gong Yi and asked about the situation of the target city of the alien race he selected.

Gong Yi told him that only the target city is called Jiujiuliu City in the local camp, which is useful information, and the rest is similar to the intelligence reconnaissance by the Zerg host.

Wu Qing determined the attack target, and a large number of Zerg puppies poured into the surrounding area of the target Jiujiuliu City, cooperating with the Zerg host to clear out the annoying goblins first.

The more than two million main combat arms of the Zerg in the 66th city were all dispatched, coming out of the Zerg underground base, and marching towards the target Jiujiuliu City.

In addition to the tens of millions of Zerg puppies that Wu Qing has successively invested in the sphere of influence of the evil god camp, the strength of the Zerg army is not less than that of the alien army, and even much more.

The main force of the Zerg, composed entirely of the main combat arms of the Zerg, including more than 500,000 Zerg air mobile forces, marched quickly towards Jiujiuliu City without any concealment.

The observers of various forces in the local camp who had been watching the movements of the main force of the Zerg immediately reported the situation to their respective forces, and followed the main force of the Zerg with their own skills.

The three tribes of bear, wolf, and eagle all received the news that the Zerg was going to fight. It is unknown whether the three outstanding figures of the three tribes will come to watch the battle.

The intelligence network of the alien race is mysterious and powerful, and they received the news of the dispatch of the main force of the Zerg at the first time.

After a little analysis, the alien race can determine the offensive target of the Zerg, and Jiujiuliu City immediately entered a wartime state.

Jiujiuliu City is not far from the 66th city occupied by the Zerg. The alien race has already made preparations for the attack of the Zerg army. Since receiving the order to enter the wartime state, all preparations have been carried out in an orderly manner.

The calm and orderly preparations for war in Jiujiuli City made Wu Qing see the powerful comprehensive capabilities of the alien race as a super race.

Wu Qing said that he would use the Zerg army as bait to attract a large number of alien army to fight and reduce the pressure on other battle zones in the public battlefield.

So what he has to do now is to use Jiujiuliu City as a battlefield to attract the alien army to come to help continuously, and try to destroy a large number of alien army in one battle.

This requires preparation for a protracted war. Jiujiuliu City cannot be captured all at once, and time must be left for the aliens to send reinforcements.

This requires that the Zerg army's lineup should not be too strong at the beginning, and the aliens should be given the hope of victory, and then continue to increase the stakes according to the actual situation on the battlefield.

Wu Qing has done this once. If he wants to fool the aliens again, he must do it more realistically.

Of course, Wu Qing also knows in his heart that with the hatred of the aliens for the Zerg, even if they understand Wu Qing's plan, the aliens will not retreat.

As a super tribe, the pride does not allow the aliens to bow to a small Zerg.

Wu Qing did this just to add another layer of insurance to the Zerg strategy.

With the escort of countless Zerg puppies, the march of the Zerg main force was very smooth.

The Zerg march was little affected by the terrain, and they marched in a straight line, directly to the protection area of the lord of the 996th city of the alien race.

A city much larger than the 66th city appeared in front of the main force of the Zerg, and the city was full of alert alien troops.

Faintly, some high shelves could be seen.
